cards.meaning: sufficiency -- the abstract state of a thing being complete or adequate, with nothing more needed
cards.example: Idineklara ng prosekusyon na may kasapatan na ang ebidensya.
cards.exampleMeaning: The prosecution declared that the evidence already has sufficiency -- that it's complete.
cards.note: Plain 'sapat na' just describes a quality in passing. 'Kasapatan' is the noun form of the concept itself -- heavier, more formal, the kind of word you'd reach for in a legal or financial report rather than casual conversation, which is why it fits a prosecution formally closing its evidentiary case.
cards.tiesTo: Duterte impeachment prosecution trims its AFP witness list, judging the Article 1 evidentiary case already complete

cards.meaning: vigilant, ongoing monitoring -- from 'bantay' (to guard/watch) -- active and repeated, not a single glance
cards.example: Nagbabantay ang BSP sa merkado ng dolyar-piso.
cards.exampleMeaning: The BSP is actively monitoring the dollar-peso market.
cards.note: 'Pagmamanman' (already taught) carries a whiff of secrecy -- watching without the subject's knowledge. 'Pagbabantay' is open and declared -- the institution itself says it is watching, nothing hidden about it -- which is the right word for a central bank publicly stating it's monitoring, not covertly surveilling.
cards.tiesTo: BSP breaks its silence, says it is actively monitoring the FX market but won't defend a specific peso rate

cards.meaning: cannot help but / have no choice but to -- an action forced by circumstance, not freely chosen
cards.example: 央行不得不干预市场，以避免汇率过度波动。
cards.examplePinyin: Yāngháng bùdébù gānyù shìchǎng, yǐ bìmiǎn huìlǜ guòdù bōdòng.
cards.exampleMeaning: The central bank had no choice but to intervene in the market, to avoid excessive exchange-rate volatility.
cards.note: 近义词 只好 (zhǐhǎo) is the more 口语, everyday version of the same idea. 不得不 works in both spoken and written registers and carries a slightly more formal, almost reluctant weight -- implying the actor genuinely didn't want to, but had no alternative.
cards.tiesTo: PBOC actively caps the yuan's rally despite strong August export data, a forced-hand intervention against the market's own trend

cards.meaning: against the trend / against the market's own momentum -- a business and finance collocation
cards.example: 尽管出口数据强劲，央行仍然逆势压低汇率。
cards.examplePinyin: Jǐnguǎn chūkǒu shùjù qiángjìng, yānghang réngrán nìshì yādī huìlǜ.
cards.exampleMeaning: Even though the export data was strong, the central bank still pushed the exchange rate down against the trend.
cards.note: 近义词 顺势 (shùnshì, 'along with the trend') is the far more common, easier move. 逆势 is notable specifically because it's harder and riskier -- you're fighting the market's own direction rather than riding it, which is exactly what the PBOC is doing here.
cards.tiesTo: PBOC's daily yuan fix sits ~640 pips weaker than market-implied fair value, one of the year's largest downside deviations
